top_band: white/light-grey rim and blue water surface from row 3 to row 10
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 2 is the top outline, rows 3-4 form the back rim, rows 5-9 show 5 rows of blue water inside the basin opening (row 5 darker water shadow under the rim, rows 6-9 lighter water surface), and row 10 is the lighter front rim edge. Below row 10, rows 11-14 form the shaded vertical front face of the tub (visibly inset by 2px on each side under the overhanging rim), with small feet on row 15.

style.evidence: While the grey/white ramp has 5-6 value steps and a dark grey-blue outline, the surfaces consist of long, unbroken horizontal bands and a large flat fill (the water is an 18x4 solid block of a single blue pixel value apart from a 2px speck, and the rim and front wall are 17-23px runs of flat colour). Compared to the richly textured stone well and grained wood stall on the left, the tub lacks surface grain, ripples, or per-tile breakup.
